esco_concept.preferred_label: interact with users to gather requirements

decision.llm_reasoning: The course objectives state the ability to build a web application from requirements analysis to deployment.

evidence.text: This course provides knowledge and skills for developing dynamic web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC. Upon completion, students will master modern web architecture, the MVC pattern, database operations via Entity Framework Core, user interface building with Razor, form handling and validation, user management with Authentication & Authorization, as well as developing practical applications with basic business logic. Additionally, the course fosters professional ethics, personal responsibility, and compliance with legal regulations during the development and deployment of web applications.
Explain the operating mechanisms of ASP.NET Core, Middleware, and Dependency Injection.
Gain a deep understanding of Entity Framework Core to perform Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) operations, queries, and database management.
Master the principles of Authentication and Authorization to secure applications.
Understand regulations on software licensing, user data security, and the responsibilities of developers toward the community.
Build flexible, highly interactive web interfaces using Razor Pages, HTML5, CSS3, and professional form handling.
Program complex business logic, control input data validation, and handle exceptions effectively.
Design and execute data query statements through LINQ and EF Core.
Possess the ability to completely build a web application from requirements analysis to actual product deployment (Basic Full-stack).
Possess the ability to configure, test, and deploy applications on hosting or server environments.
Apply appropriate security standards and legal regulations in storing and processing users' personal data.
ASP.NET Core Fundamentals and Entity Framework Core
File Upload, Searching, Pagination & Basic Security
